text: {"assertions":["A spurious 429 rate limit error occurred in api/gateway/rate_limit.go affecting only clients using the v1 SDK.","The root cause was a naive datetime being compared against a timezone-aware datetime, causing throttle counters to exceed the configured ceiling.","The fix made all boundary datetimes timezone-aware at the edge, submitted as PR #4328 on branch fix/spurious-429-1.","The issue was reproduced using a saved burst fixture in the rate limiter test (api/gateway/rate_limit_test.go).","The spurious 429 issue was addressed on 2026-03-19.","After the fix was deployed, the rate limit alert remained quiet for 48 consecutive days."]}
